documents.text: The coastal observatory records salinity each morning. Calibration occurs before the first reading, and anomalous measurements require a second instrument.

# Recovery manual

Stop writes before taking a snapshot.

## Restore

Verify the checksum manifest before switching generations. Never overwrite the active generation during rehearsal.

# Retention policy

Customer records are retained for thirty days after closure. Legal holds suspend deletion.

## Exceptions

Audit records remain for seven years; test fixtures expire after one day.

# Support windows

| Tier | Response | Coverage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Critical | 15 minutes | 24x7 |
| Standard | 8 hours | Weekdays |

# Authentication

Keys identify a tenant and its allowed scopes.

## Rotation

Create the replacement key before revoking the old key.

## Audit

Both creation and revocation must appear in the administrative audit log.
